title: Sum of Two Integers
keyIdea: Binary addition without +: a ^ b adds each column ignoring carries, (a & b) << 1 is the carry into the next column. Set a = a ^ b, b = carry and repeat until the carry is 0. Two's complement makes negatives work too.

approaches.name: XOR + carry loop
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code): while b != 0: carry = (unsigned)(a & b) << 1; a ^= b; b = carry.
approaches.why: The carry moves at least one bit left each round, so at most 32 rounds.

options: The sum of each column without carries

quiz.q: Why cast to unsigned before << in C++?
options: Left-shifting a negative int is undefined behaviour
The carry shifts left every round and falls off after 32 bits
